name: Cross-venue funding differential carry
hypothesis: Hold offsetting authorized contracts only when expected funding differential exceeds both-leg costs and venue-risk buffers.
spec: Setup: Comparable derivative venues may pay different funding rates. Entry: Hold offsetting authorized contracts only when expected funding differential exceeds both-leg costs and venue-risk buffers. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Close on differential decay, basis stop, or collateral stress. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs funding/basis history and hedged derivative legs (not connected)
